title: Ethiopian Amete Alem Calendar
intro: Amete Alem is the Ethiopian Year of the World era convention.
structure: The Ethiopian year contains twelve 30-day months and a final month of five or six days. The Alexandrian-style leap cycle determines Pagume's length.
model: The provider uses Ethiopian arithmetic with an era offset of 5500 years relative to Amete Mihret. The same underlying day has the same month and day in both conventions.
example: Year 2018 Amete Mihret corresponds to year 7518 Amete Alem on the same month and day.
history: Ethiopian historical and religious references may employ distinct era counts. The era name and date convention must be identified before interpreting such a record.
limits: A separate provider, not an alias of Amete Mihret. Arithmetic continuation does not certify every historical use.
